fpcubeR: read the Florida Pasture Cube

Source: R/fpcubeR-package.R
fpcubeR-package.Rd

The Florida Pasture Cube describes 62,847 persistent pasture fields in Florida every 5 days from January 2016 to October 2026 with HLS optical reflectance and indices, Sentinel-1 backscatter and PRISM weather, together with soil, terrain and wetland attributes and drought, pasture condition and hurricane labels.

Details

  • Get the data: fpc_download(), fpc_files(), fpc_dir(), fpc_verify().

  • Read it: fpc_fields(), fpc_composites(), fpc_variables(), fpc_observations(), fpc_labels().

  • Analyse it: fpc_add_drought(), fpc_climatology(), fpc_anomaly(), fpc_summarise().

  • Plot it: fpc_plot_field(), fpc_map_fields().

  • Try it without downloading: fpc_example_dir().

Data: CC BY 4.0, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.24542431. Cite the data set when you use it.
